messages:
leah: quick triage note 1: onboarding sable-30b int3 with streaming-prefill (50k). deterministic split vs oracle at token 32768 (32k). kv checksum mismatch and small rotor-phase offset seen in ropestate.

devon: ouch. 32k boundary sounds like a tile flush edge. what's KV_TILE_SIZE and prefill stride?

leah: default KV_TILE_SIZE=8192, PREFILL_STRIDE=8192. repro command: 
```
./onboard.sh --model sable-30b --quant int3 --context 51200 --prefill streaming --seed 123 --kv-debug=1
```
Log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-24T15:02:01Z] prefilling streaming len=51200
[2026-03-24T15:02:45Z] kv.checksum(oracle)=0x5c4a9f3b
[2026-03-24T15:02:45Z] kv.checksum(live)=0x5c4a9eaf  <-- divergence @ token 32768
```

sam: interesting. ropestate shows phase_accum mismatch ~+/- 3 units right after tile boundary. maybe rounding in int3 quant kernel or cross-shard ACK reorder.

mira: try ROTARY_WRAP_POLICY=clamp vs staggered and also KV_TILE_SIZE=4096 to see if boundary moves predictably. also run a FP16-only build to isolate quant kernel.

leah: launching three quick jobs: 1) TILE=4096, 2) ROTARY_WRAP=staggered, 3) FP16 fallback. infra-bot queued.

infra-bot: CI job queued: https://ci.redwood/eng-ml/17422 (tile-4096)
infra-bot: CI job queued: https://ci.redwood/eng-ml/17423 (rotary-staggered)
infra-bot: CI job queued: https://ci.redwood/eng-ml/17424 (fp16-fallback)

devon: also add a single-shard local run with ASYNC_KV_FLUSH=0 to rule out interleaving between shard flush and phase update. if single-shard passes, it's almost certainly handshake ordering.

leah: good call. I'll run single-shard + ASYNC_KV_FLUSH=0 and post kvsync.log + ropestate dump. also making a tiny unit test that replays first 33k tokens and asserts kv checksums match oracle. should help bisecting faster.

sam: if unit test fails, bisect plan: toggle quant pack/unpack code paths, then kernel rounding mode (TRUNCATE vs ROUND). capture the exact token window +/- 16 and compare logits/embeddings to find semantic drift onset.

leah: adding that to the todo. will upload artifacts and update here when CI finishes (~25-35m).
